questions.question: God told Moses to make an altar of acacia wood covered with gold for the tabernacle. What was it for?
When Moses counted the Israelites, what did God say the atonement money from each man would be used for?

answers.text: The service of the Tent of Meeting
Gifts for the poor in Israel

questions.question: Why did God tell Aaron and his sons to wash their hands and feet at the bronze basin?

answers.text: So that they would not die
So that the people would trust them
So that the altar would stay clean
